# owasp-api-2023

OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023): object-level authorization, broken authentication, property-level exposure, rate limiting and the rest of the list every SECURITY finding cites.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model api-gateway --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model asyncapi --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show owasp-api-2023`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-SEC-001, AF-SEC-002, AF-SEC-003, AF-SEC-004, AF-SEC-005, AF-SEC-006, AF-SEC-007, AF-SEC-008
